+def _is_safe(node):
+    if isinstance(node, ast.Constant):
+        return isinstance(node.value, (int, str))
+    elif isinstance(node, ast.Name):
+        return node.id in ["id", "name", "email"]
+    elif isinstance(node, ast.Compare):
+        return _is_safe(node.left) and all(_is_safe(c) for c in node.comparators)
+    elif isinstance(node, ast.BoolOp):
+        return all(_is_safe(v) for v in node.values)
+    elif isinstance(node, ast.UnaryOp):
+        return isinstance(node.op, ast.Not) and _is_safe(node.operand)
+    return False
+
+
+def _evaluate(node, context):
+    if isinstance(node, ast.Constant):
+        return node.value
+    elif isinstance(node, ast.Name):
+        return context[node.id]
+    elif isinstance(node, ast.Compare):
+        left = _evaluate(node.left, context)
+        ops = {
+            ast.Eq: operator.eq,
+            ast.NotEq: operator.ne,
+            ast.Lt: operator.lt,
+            ast.LtE: operator.le,
+            ast.Gt: operator.gt,
+            ast.GtE: operator.ge,
+        }
+        for op, comparator in zip(node.ops, node.comparators):
+            right = _evaluate(comparator, context)
+            if not ops[type(op)](left, right):
+                return False
+            left = right
+        return True
+    elif isinstance(node, ast.BoolOp):
+        values = [_evaluate(v, context) for v in node.values]
+        if isinstance(node.op, ast.And):
+            return all(values)
+        if isinstance(node.op, ast.Or):
+            return any(values)
+    elif isinstance(node, ast.UnaryOp):
+        if isinstance(node.op, ast.Not):
+            return not _evaluate(node.operand, context)
+    raise ValueError("Unsupported operation")
+
+
+def handle_filter_users(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    where = params.get("where")
+    if not isinstance(where, str):
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid filter"}
+    try:
+        tree = ast.parse(where, mode='eval')
+        if not _is_safe(tree.body):
+            return 400, {"error": "invalid filter"}
+
+        all_users = users.get_all()
+        filtered = [u for u in all_users if _evaluate(tree.body, u)]
+        filtered.sort(key=lambda u: u["id"])
+        return 200, {"users": filtered}
+    except Exception:
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid filter"}

def test_handle_filter_users():
    # Test valid filter
    code, result = handle_filter_users({"where": "id > 1"})
    assert code == 200
    assert len(result["users"]) == 1
    assert result["users"][0]["id"] == 2
    
    # Test valid filter
    code, result = handle_filter_users({"where": "name == 'Ada'"})
    assert code == 200
    assert len(result["users"]) == 1
    assert result["users"][0]["name"] == 'Ada'

    # Test invalid filter (missing)
    code, result = handle_filter_users({})
    assert code == 400
    
    # Test invalid filter (syntax)
    code, result = handle_filter_users({"where": "id + 1 == 2"})
    assert code == 400
    
    # Test invalid filter (injection)
    code, result = handle_filter_users({"where": "__import__('os')"})
    assert code == 400

    # Test valid boolean expression
    code, result = handle_filter_users({"where": "id == 1 or id == 2"})
    assert code == 200
    assert len(result["users"]) == 2
